title: Transversal architecture for megaquop-scale quantum simulation with neutral atoms
abstract: Proposes a 'transversal STAR' fault-tolerant architecture co-designed with neutral-atom hardware to cut resource overhead for FT quantum simulation of local Hamiltonians. Estimates ~10,000 physical qubits at a 1e-3 physical error rate, substantially below conventional fully-fault-tolerant methods (millions of T gates). Notes an extension to high-rate quantum codes (realized in the follow-up arXiv:2606.25011 / PAPER-120).
key_claims: Transversal STAR architecture: ~10,000 physical qubits at 1e-3 error for FT simulation of local Hamiltonians.

Predecessor (Sept 2025, revised May 2026) to the high-rate STAR architecture of arXiv:2606.25011 (PAPER-120); the high-rate variant's ~2,240-qubit 8x8-TFIM figure is the ~5.5x improvement over this baseline.
Required input to the HYP-029 digital-FT resource estimate: costing BOTH STAR variants (transversal vs high-rate) bounds the budget uncertainty.
relation: Companion/predecessor to PAPER-2026-120 (2606.25011). Both are required inputs to HYP-2026-029.
